name: setup
eval: (()=>{const A=__grahan,G=A.game,W=G.world,GR=W.greenery;const ok=(c,m)=>{if(!c)throw new Error('ASSERT '+m);};const R1=(v)=>Math.round(v*10)/10;A.set('manual',true);A.set('invulnerable',true);A.set('hazards',false);A.setTime(10);A.teleport(75,38,-62,0);A.step(0.5);ok(GR,'world.greenery exists (buildGreenery ran)');const st=GR.stats;const by={};for(const p of GR.plants){by[p.kind]=(by[p.kind]||0)+1;}const lv={};for(const p of GR.plants){lv[p.level]=(lv[p.level]||0)+1;}for(const k of ['palm','rain','gulmohar','peepal','creeper','hedge','bed','shrub','green-wall','balcony','tulsi','ledge-pot','top-palm','drape']) ok((by[k]||0)>0,'has '+k);ok(by.peepal===1,'exactly one peepal');ok(lv.G<=45,'G has almost none: '+lv.G);ok(lv.L1===undefined||lv.L1<=6,'L1 has almost none: '+lv.L1);ok(lv.L3>lv.L2*2,'green is a privilege of height: '+JSON.stringify(lv));const towers=W.map.towers.filter(t=>!t.roof&&t.h>=40&&Math.min(t.x1-t.x0,t.z1-t.z0)>=14);ok(GR.debug.topped<=Math.ceil(towers.length*0.5),'most towers are bare: '+GR.debug.topped+' of '+towers.length);return {ms:st.ms,plants:st.plants,byKind:by,byLevel:lv,towersTopped:GR.debug.topped,towers:towers.length,tris:st.tris,colliders:st.colliders};})()

name: approaches-clear
eval: (()=>{const A=__grahan,G=A.game,W=G.world,GR=W.greenery;const ok=(c,m)=>{if(!c)throw new Error('ASSERT '+m);};const R1=(v)=>Math.round(v*10)/10;const v=GR.verify();ok(v.overlaps.length===0,'a plant overlaps an approach: '+v.overlaps.slice(0,4));ok(v.blocked.length===0,'a plant blocks a route: '+v.blocked.slice(0,4));const near=[];for(const i of G.interactables.list()){for(const p of GR.plants){if(p.kind==='creeper'||p.kind==='green-wall'||p.kind.startsWith('top-'))continue;if(Math.abs(p.y-i.pos.y)<2.5&&Math.hypot(p.x-i.pos.x,p.z-i.pos.z)<1.2+p.r*0.5)near.push(p.kind+'@'+i.id);}}ok(near.length===0,'a plant is on an interactable: '+near.slice(0,4));const gates=W.map.gates;const bad=[];for(const g of gates){for(const p of GR.plants){if(!p.solid||Math.abs(p.y-g.y)>2)continue;if(Math.hypot(p.x-g.x,p.z-g.z)<5)bad.push(p.kind+'@'+g.id);}}ok(bad.length===0,'a plant is at a gate: '+bad.slice(0,4));return {checked:v.checked,zones:v.zones,interactables:G.interactables.list().length,gates:gates.length,lifts:W.lifts.length};})()

name: walk-pod-routes
eval: (()=>{const A=__grahan,G=A.game,W=G.world,GR=W.greenery;const ok=(c,m)=>{if(!c)throw new Error('ASSERT '+m);};const R1=(v)=>Math.round(v*10)/10;A.teleport(75,38,-64,0);A.step(0.2);const w1=A.walk([[75,-72],[75,-90],[93,-80],[100,-90],[110,-90]]);ok(w1.ok,'walk pod-3-1 bridge->hub->lift->east bridge: '+w1.log.slice(-2));A.teleport(75,38,-56,180);A.step(0.2);const w2=A.walk([[75,-48],[75,-30],[90,-30],[100,-30]]);ok(w2.ok,'walk pod-3-2 routes: '+w2.log.slice(-2));return {w1:w1.log[w1.log.length-1],w2:w2.log[w2.log.length-1]};})()

name: drape-over-the-edge
eval: (()=>{const A=__grahan,G=A.game,W=G.world,GR=W.greenery;const ok=(c,m)=>{if(!c)throw new Error('ASSERT '+m);};const R1=(v)=>Math.round(v*10)/10;const d=GR.plants.filter(q=>q.kind==='drape'&&q.level==='L3'&&q.y>38&&Math.abs(q.z+60)<14&&q.nz*(-60-q.z)>0&&q.x>50&&q.x<160).sort((p,q)=>q.r-p.r)[0];ok(d,'a drape on a pod face over the EEH flyover');A.setTime(10.5);A.set('freeze',false);const px=d.x,pz=-60,tx=d.x,tz=d.z,ty=d.y-3;A.teleport(px,24,pz,0);A.look(Math.atan2(-(tx-px),-(tz-pz))*180/Math.PI,Math.atan2(ty-25.6,Math.hypot(tx-px,tz-pz))*180/Math.PI);A.step(0.3);return {drape:[R1(d.x),R1(d.z)],len:R1(d.r*2),count:GR.plants.filter(q=>q.kind==='drape').length};})()

name: g-dead-tree-stays-dead
eval: (()=>{const A=__grahan,G=A.game,W=G.world,GR=W.greenery;const ok=(c,m)=>{if(!c)throw new Error('ASSERT '+m);};const R1=(v)=>Math.round(v*10)/10;A.teleport(-45,0,22,0);A.look(180,10);A.step(0.3);ok(!GR.plants.some(p=>Math.hypot(p.x+45,p.z-36)<10&&p.level==='G'),'nothing alive near the dead tree');})()

name: sing-patched
eval: (()=>{const A=__grahan,G=A.game,W=G.world,GR=W.greenery;const ok=(c,m)=>{if(!c)throw new Error('ASSERT '+m);};const R1=(v)=>Math.round(v*10)/10;ok(GR.debug.layers.every(l=>l.mat.userData&&l.mat.userData.sensePatched),'the greenery material is opted in to the senses patch');return {patched:true};})()

name: budget-read
eval: (()=>{const A=__grahan,G=A.game,W=G.world,GR=W.greenery;const ok=(c,m)=>{if(!c)throw new Error('ASSERT '+m);};const R1=(v)=>Math.round(v*10)/10;const r=A.state().render,g=A.state().greenery;ok(g.calls<=2,'greenery is at most 2 draw calls (3 at night): '+g.calls);ok(g.visible.tris<=60000,'greenery triangles in view: '+g.visible.tris);ok(r.calls<=150,'whole scene draw calls: '+r.calls);return {sceneCalls:r.calls,sceneTriangles:r.triangles,greeneryCalls:g.calls,greeneryTriangles:g.visible.tris,cells:g.visible.cells,lod0:g.visible.lod0};})()

name: budget-night-read
eval: (()=>{const A=__grahan,G=A.game,W=G.world,GR=W.greenery;const ok=(c,m)=>{if(!c)throw new Error('ASSERT '+m);};const R1=(v)=>Math.round(v*10)/10;const r=A.state().render,g=A.state().greenery;ok(g.calls<=3,'greenery is at most 3 draw calls at night: '+g.calls);ok(r.calls<=150,'whole scene draw calls at night: '+r.calls);return {sceneCalls:r.calls,sceneTriangles:r.triangles,greeneryCalls:g.calls,greeneryTriangles:g.visible.tris};})()
